summary: This class models the Printers flow for Android mobile app automation testing. It extends SmartFlow base class and implements comprehensive printer management functionality including WiFi Direct, network printers, OOBE setup, and various printer connection methods. The class follows Page Object Model (POM) pattern with clear separation between action flows (select_*, connect_*, etc.) and verification flows (verify_*). It includes platform-specific handling for different Android versions (7-12+), extensive permission management, popup handling, and robust error handling with retry logic. Key patterns include: scrolling with timeout, element waiting with format specifiers, exception handling for stale elements, and conditional flows based on Android platform version. The class supports multiple printer discovery methods (IP address, bonjour name, WiFi Direct, OOBE), connection types (WiFi, Ethernet), and includes comprehensive verification methods for all UI screens and popups in the printer setup workflow.
